name: Durvasa of Wayal
source:
Durvasa of Wayal is a member of the inner circle of the Order of the Universal Panacea. He is a biomancer, and the one primarily responsible for the Everblossom. He has a background as a wartime medic, and then a high-level official in the Grand Alliance, although he has since mostly retired from such things to focus on research.

[From [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Durvasa_of_Wayal]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
